actions.query: YouTube zork transcript moves solution.txt prior evidence

contract.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, transcribe the full on-screen text, and create /app/solution.txt containing every player move in order, one move per line.
required_behaviors: Obtain the video or a transcript from the referenced YouTube URL
Extract the complete sequence of player inputs/moves from the content
Write the moves to /app/solution.txt with exactly one move per line
Preserve the original move text formatting such as 'n' or 'get bag'
known_invalid_patterns: Only creating a non-empty file without verifying it matches the video
Using compile/smoke/file-existence checks as a substitute for extracting the moves
Producing a partial move list or omitting moves
Inventing moves not supported by the video/transcript
verification_plan: Inspect prior receipts and workspace for cached transcript or helper artifacts
If needed, retrieve or derive the transcript from the video source
Cross-check the extracted move list against the source content
Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted move sequence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence showing the source/transcript used to derive the move list
Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt was written with the extracted moves
Receipt-backed evidence that the written file content matches the extracted move sequence
notes: If a cached transcript or prior receipt exists, prefer it over repeating equivalent work.

plan.current_focus: Find cached evidence or transcript for the referenced YouTube video, then extract and write the move list.
next_steps: Inspect prior receipts for any cached transcript or video-derived text
Search workspace for helper artifacts or cached downloads
If source is accessible, derive the move list from the transcript/video text
Write /app/solution.txt and verify against the extracted sequence

items: Locate prior receipts or cached artifacts for the YouTube video
Obtain transcript/source text for the video
Extract every player move in order
Verify file content against extracted moves
